snippet.title: Massive Collapse Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434900/Massive_Collapse/

Massive Collapse is an 8v8, round-based multiplayer shooter developed by a small indie studio where every match begins with a new build. Choose your race, combine spells and gadgets to create new strategies built to outmaneuver, outplay, and overwhelm your opponents.

Multiplayer demo releases soon. 

Join the discord for a potential to get early access! https://discord.gg/QPUZk9VCFB

#MassiveCollapse #indiegame  #fps  #unrealengine  #gaming
